question: Do the decode-granularity switches start at design?

artifacts.summary: The switches cut from #425, with the case for them: 9.96 to 7.20 English and 11.08 to 9.63 Mandarin on 150 clips per language, intervals excluding zero, one flip instead of the whole gap. The trade is stated in the same table: first-visible unchanged, first-committed plus four to five seconds, and visible changes going from half appends to 95 to 97 percent rewrites. The caveat that decides it is that every measurement is single-sentence FLEURS audio.
